limits: Synthetic capture peer supports POST/GET only; no PUT state transition or production UPS server acceptance claim.
Native Basic request headers are verified; CLI requests intentionally omit Basic because it has no Basic flag. Server credential enforcement is not tested.
Bearer/none UPS transitions are copied-preview observations only, not additional executed requests.
The existing create-json route preserves compact DICOM DT; native Scheduled Start field expects ISO8601 and was not given compact DT.

Input00080018 is omitted by both creation clients for peer-assigned identity. All other input attributes are compared exactly. Initial audit incorrectly expected that UID in POST; the failed oracle receipt is retained.

creation_identity_source_proof.rule: createWorkitem(workitem:uid:) defaults uid to nil, uses POST /workitems when nil, removes00080018 from JSON body, and extracts response identity from Location. Both JSON clients omit the uid argument.
